autonomous-worker-routing-certify.description: Certify zero-cost Spark route selection, exhausted-capacity retention and paid-fallback rejection without starting a model turn.

codex-worker-result-classifier-certify.description: Certify observed Codex result classification for available, exhausted, rate-limited, authentication and degraded states without querying account usage or starting a model turn.

codex-worker-runner-safety-certify.description: Prove the effectful Codex worker runner remains disabled without both explicit runtime and physical-profile acceptance gates. Does not require Codex or start a model turn.

codex-worker-capability-probe.description: Inspect the installed Codex CLI version and exec help, proving supported structured-output, model-selection, sandbox and approval controls without authentication mutation, model inference or repository effects.
